glossary.definition: LESSON 1.1 The concept of democracy and democratization 1.1.1 Definition of democracy There is no absolute definition of democracy
The word democracy was derived from two Greek words: "Demo" and "Kratos", which means people and rule (legitimate power to rule), respectively

glossary.term: LESSON 1.2 Definitions And Actors Of Dem
glossary.definition: LESSON 1.2 Definitions and actors of democratization process 1.2.1 The meaning of democratization Democratization is a complex, long-term, dynamic, and open-ended process
Actors in democratization process Democracy is a process which is not an overnight program
Civil societies Like political parties, non-governmental associations and organizations are valuable vectors of democracy
